documents.quote: Date: 2026-01-08 | Record: URS-IAQ-001 | Revision: A | Status: Released | Affected Item(s): CO2 limit, room volume, occupant emission | Change Summary: Initial owner requirements issued. | Approved By: M. Ortega | Precedence Note: Baseline requirement source.

Date: 2026-01-22 | Record: MDS-IAQ-01 | Revision: 1.1 | Status: Released | Affected Item(s): Room and air-flow modeling data | Change Summary: 100 m3 volume and 1.2 kg/m3 nominal density frozen. | Approved By: L. Chen | Precedence Note: Technical basis.

Date: 2026-02-01 | Record: CDS-IAQ-02 | Revision: A | Status: Released | Affected Item(s): Controller tuning | Change Summary: Initial Kp=4.0 and integral enabled. | Approved By: N. Shah | Precedence Note: Superseded in part by CR-IAQ-007.

Date: 2026-02-07 | Record: ICD-IAQ-03 | Revision: B | Status: Released | Affected Item(s): Signal units and normalization | Change Summary: Trace-substance interfaces frozen in kg/kg. | Approved By: N. Shah | Precedence Note: Controls interface baseline.

Date: 2026-02-14 | Record: DR-IAQ-05 | Revision: Final | Status: Approved | Affected Item(s): CO2 compliance interpretation | Change Summary: Confirmed 1000 ppm absolute, rejected '1000 ppm above outdoor' interpretation. | Approved By: Design Review Board | Precedence Note: Approved decision resolves email ambiguity.

Date: 2026-02-21 | Record: OCC-SCH-04 | Revision: C | Status: Approved | Affected Item(s): Occupancy schedule | Change Summary: Peak occupancy increased from 12 to 15 people for 13:00-15:00. | Approved By: Facilities | Precedence Note: Latest operational schedule.

Date: 2026-02-28 | Record: CR-IAQ-007 | Revision: 1 | Status: Approved | Affected Item(s): Controller tuning | Change Summary: Kp changed 4.0 -> 6.0, bias set to 3.5 ACH, integral disabled for released reference run. | Approved By: M. Ortega | Precedence Note: Overrides CDS-IAQ-02 Rev A tuning.

Date: 2026-03-03 | Record: CP-23 | Revision: C | Status: Released | Affected Item(s): Verification | Change Summary: 24-hour trend test and <=1000 ppm acceptance criteria issued. | Approved By: V&V Lead | Precedence Note: Verification authority.

Date: 2026-03-05 | Record: SIM-LEGACY | Revision: 0.9 | Status: Archived | Affected Item(s): Legacy Modelica model | Change Summary: Archived model still uses 12-person peak and 350 ppm outdoor CO2. | Approved By: L. Chen | Precedence Note: Known stale source; useful for architecture only.
